Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all from this game! West Indies have won the series and there are still two games to go. Australia, on the other hand, have a lot of work to do if they want to try and finish the series with wins. The 4th T20I will be played on Thursday, 15th July 2021 at 1930 local (2330 GMT). Do join us for that game. Cheers and take care.

Nicholas Pooran, the winning skipper is up for a chat. He says it was a top game. They came out and executed the plan with the bat as well as the ball. Also praises Chris Gayle and he is happy to see him back in form. Adds the knowledge in the dressing room helps him a lot during his captaincy phase. Also says Pollard is a true mentor and he always is there to help him in the back end. Also says he would like to seal the series with a whitewash. Ends by saying this will help the spirit of the team.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that they have not had the top order continue for long and the middle order is a struggle. Adds that West Indies bowled beautifully especially at the death. Goes onto say that they would have loved more runs and that comes down to the top order not batting through. Goes onto say that his wicket exposed two new batters in the middle. Tells that international cricket is tough and they are playing against a top side but there are new excuses. Goes onto say that Meredith bowled well and they started well with the ball and hopes that they keep improving.

Chris Gayle, Man of the Match. He says it was a great journey and was happy to seal the series. Also praises Pooran and Pollard for their efforts. Also says he pleased that his teammates have always supported him. Adds that he likes the unity amongst the team and says this will help them a lot to be stronger. Also says his main aim is to concentrate on the upcoming T20 World Cup and that they are on track. He also praises the young guys in the team for their effort with the bat and ball. Adds that Australia lost a lot of players and pays respect to Finch. Adds they are going through a building phase. Ends by saying they are a really good opposition and would be back in no time once they find their rhythm.
Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony!

Australia, ohh, Australia. They have just not turned up in the series, neither with the bat nor with the ball. They started well with Mitchell Starc getting his first wicket of the series in the first over and he was the only economical bowler for the visitors. Riley Meredith did pick up three wickets but was too expensive, Hazlewood too went for runs while Zampa had a tough game with the ball. They needed early wickets but that did not come and one feels that they had too few runs on the board.

West Indies, were not off to the greatest of starts as they lost Andre Fletcher early on in the chase but Simmons and Gayle stitched a handy stand with Gayle being the aggressor. Simmons fell just at the end of the Powerplay and runs dried up. Gayle took his time after that and Pooran started off slowly but after the 10th over, Chris Gayle went berserk as he hit the ball to all parts of the ground and scored 67 and announced his return to form in style. Nicholas Pooran played a perfect supporting role and then strut his stuff after Gayle fell. In the end, they won by 6 wickets and 31 balls to spare.

Excellent performance from West Indies! They have won the series with 2 games to spare and they could not have asked for a better performance after the series defeat to South Africa earlier. Australia, on the other hand, were poor once again with both bat and ball and they have been thrashed.

FOUR! Shot of authority! A length ball, on off. Pooran stays back and pulls it through mid-wikcet for the winning boundary. Nicholas Pooran is pumped. West Indies seal the series here. THEY WIN BY 6 WICKETS.
FOUR! Nicely played. A length ball, on the pads. Pooran flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary. 4 more required to win.
WIDE! A short ball, on off. Pooran leaves it. Wide called.
A full length ball, on middle. Andre Russell works it to square leg off the inner half of the blade. The batters take a single.
SIX! Bang! Russell needs no sighter! Good length ball on off, Russell hammers it over long on for a biggie. No Ball and a Free Hit will follow.
Full on the pads, Pooran works it to long on for one.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Andre Russell who walks in at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent catch from Adam Zampa but is it too late? Good length ball around off, Bravo looks to go over the off side but one hand comes off the handle and it goes off the outside edge to backward point. Zampa runs backwards, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a very good catch. Meredith on a Hat-Trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Adam Zampa b Riley Meredith

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! Full outside off, Pooran drives it through point for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Starc has got a finger on it but Bravo is in! Low full toss on middle, Pooran drives it back to the bowler. Starc seems to have got a finger on it and it hits the stumps at his end. Starc appeals and the third umpire is called for. The replays roll in and they show that Bravo is in.
Umpire's review for run out. The replays roll in and confirms that the bowler had made a contact with the ball. Also, the batter was well inside the crease. The decision is Not Out.
Fullish ball on off, pushed to deep cover for a single.
Full on off, Bravo defends it to mid off.
Full on middle, Bravo flicks it to deep mid-wicket for two.
Full on middle, Pooran looks to flick but gets an inside edge towards the leg side for one.
Mitchell Starc comes back into the attack. His figures are 3-0-7-1 so far. He replaces Riley Meredith.
FOUR! Top shot! Good length ball outside off, Bravo punches it through the cover region for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Bravo looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the umpire says no.
Short ball outside off, Bravo sways away from it.
Good length ball on off, Pooran pushes it to point for one.
Full on the pads, Pooran clips it to deep square leg for a couple.
Good length ball on off, Pooran plays it to cover.
Who will walk in at number 5? It is going to be Dwayne Bravo. Also, Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack now. He replaces Adam Zampa.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The entertainment ends! Chris Gayle walks back but not before doing his job. What an innings from the Universe Boss. Short ball outside off, Gayle clears his front leg and looks to pull but gets an outside edge and goes to the keeper, Matthew Wade who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Riley Meredith

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Bang! This is the Chris Gayle of old! Wow, what a superb piece of batting. Full on the pads, Gayle nonchalantly lifts it over deep square leg for a maximum.
SIX! Ohh, goodness! That is dynamic, powerful and out of the ground. Short on middle, Gayle powers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That ball is not coming back, it seems.
Low full toss on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.
WIDE! Good length ball down the leg side, Pooran looks to flick but misses.
Short ball on middle, Gayle clears his front leg and then pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Good length ball on off, Pooran defends it to mid off and takes a quick run.
Riley Meredith comes back into the attack. He replaces Mitchell Starc.
Flatter outside off, Gayle looks to defend but misses.
SIX! Christopher Henry Gayle is back in form and in some style! First half-century in T20Is for Gayle since 2016. Loopy ball on middle, Gayle slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
SIX! Smacked! Magnificent ball striking from Chris Gayle! Loopy ball on middle, Gayle powers it over long on for a maximum.
SIX! A rank long hop from Zampa and Gayle punishes it! Short ball on the leg stump line, Gayle rocks on his back foot and then powers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter ball outside off, Gayle looks to cut but misses.
EDGED AND FOUR! Fortunate but Gayle won't mind! Tossed up outside off, Gayle looks to slog sweep but gets an outside edge and it flies to third man for a boundary.
A single to end the over. A length ball, on off. Gayle guides it towards third man for a single.
A full length delivery, on off. Gayle works it to the offside. Five dots on the trot.
A full length ball, on off. Gayle pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length ball, on off. Gayle leaves it alone.
Review time! Australia have taken a review for LBW. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that it is missing the leg stump.

NOT OUT! Australia waste another review as they have nothing left in the bank anoymore. A full length ball, on middle and leg. Chris Gayle plays around it. He misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. There is a loud appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested. Aaron Finch takes the review with just a second to spare. The Ultra Edge shows the bat is absent. The Ball Tracker shows the wickets are missing. Gayle is still in the middle.
A full length ball, on off. Gayle looks to flick but gets an outside edge as the ball rolls to the left of Matthew Wade behind the wickets.
WIDE! A full length ball, down the leg side. Chris Gayle leaves it alone. Wide called.
Full and on off, Pooran looks to go big but does not get the connection. The ball takes the toe end and rolls out to the off side.
On off, Pooran defends it out solidly.
WIDE! Loopy ball, down the leg side. Pooran looks to pull it away but misses. Wide called.

A loud appeal for LBW turned down. Full and on middle. Nicholas Pooran looks to sweep it but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Zampa appeals for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Replays roll in and show that the ball was pitching outside leg.
On off, Nicholas Pooran defends it out.
Flatter on off, Gayle works it to long on for a single.

SIX! BANG! Chris Gayle becomes the first batsman to reach 14,000 runs in T20 cricket. Full and on leg, Gayle moves to the leg side and makes room for himself. He powers it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Good length ball, outside off, swinging away. Nicholas Pooran looks to reach it but misses. The ball ends up with the keeper.
A length ball, on off. Pooran pulls it towards mid-wicket.
A full length ball, on off, Gayle works it to mid on for another single.
A length ball, outside off. Pooran pushes it to cover for a single.
Play and a miss! On a length, outside off. Pooran looks to chase it but misses. The ball bounces over the bat.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Pooran gets the sweetest of connections. A touch short on off. Pooran stays back and pulls it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack.
Tossed up, on off. Pooran works it to long off for another single. A tidy over by Adam Zampa.
On off, Gayle pushes it gently to mid off for another single.
Floated, on off. Pooran gets back and punches it through cover for a single.
Tossed up, on leg. Gayle tucks it to square leg and rotates the strike.
On middle, Gayle defends it out.
Looped up, down the leg side. Gayle looks to tuck it but misses. The ball rolls towards short fine leg off the pads.
Adam Zampa is on now.
A full length ball, on off. Nicholas Pooran works it to mid off.
WIDE! A short ball, on middle. Nicholas Pooran ducks under it. Umpire signals it as a wide due to the height.
A length ball, on off. Pooran defends it out.
Good length ball on the pads, Pooran works it to the fine leg region for a couple.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.

EDGED AND FOUR! Just wide of the fielder at first slip! Full outside off, Pooran looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge and goes to the left of first slip. Finch dives, gets a fingertip on it and it goes to third man for a boundary.
Nicholas Pooran is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies are two man down now. Riley Meredith strikes in his second over, to put the Aussies is a better position. Serves a good length ball, on off. Lendl Simmons moves back to the leg side and lifts it towards the man at backward point. He does not get the distance on it. Mitchell Starc takes a sharp catch in the deep. Lendl Simmons is not happy with himself.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Riley Meredith

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball around middle, Gayle ducks under it.
Good length ball on middle, Simmons plays it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! This is some shot from Simmons! Full on off, Simmons gives himself some room and then lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.

An appeal for LBW turned down! Full on the pads, Gayle looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Hazlewood appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Gayle wants the leg bye and takes off. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Simmons punches it to deep cover for a single.
Short ball on middle, Gayle pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Josh Hazlewood changes end now, as he comes back into the attack. He replaces Mitchell Starc. His figures 1-0-19-0 so far.
FOUR! This is brilliant! Good length ball outside off, Simmons cuts it through the point region for a boundary. 9 runs from the over. 108 needed in 96 balls.
FOUR! Full on the pads, Simmons clears his front leg and then flicks it. It is not of the middle of the bat but enough to reach the deep mid-wicket fence.
Full on the pads, Gayle works it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower ball outside off, Gayle slaps it to mid off. Three dots in a row.
Length ball on off, Gayle defends it to cover.
Short ball around off, Gayle looks to pull but misses.
Riley Meredith comes into the attack now. He replaces Josh Hazlewood.
Full outside off, Simmons pushes it to point.
On a length on off, Simmons blocks it to point.
Another appeal for LBW turned down! Full on the pads, Simmons looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Starc appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
Fullish ball on off, Simmons defends it to cover.
On a length on middle, Gayle nudges it to deep square leg for one.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg and Australia take a review. Good length ball on the pads, Simmons looks to heave it to the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Australia appeal but the umpire says no. Starc and Finch discuss for the review and Finch takes it. The Ultra Edge shows no bat while the Ball Tracker shows that it is pitching outside leg. A leg bye taken.
Aaron Finch takes it upstairs for a LBW review. The onfield decision is Not Out. The Ultra Edge shows no bat in involved. The Ball Tracker shows the ball is pitching outside leg. The decision stands.
FOUR! Get out of the way, Hazlewood! Gayle looks in the mood tonight. Full on middle, Gayle whacks it straight back. Hazlewood ducks and the ball goes to the fence like a tracer bullet.
FOUR! Gayle is tearing into Hazlewood at the moment! Short on middle, Gayle pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Whipped away! This was hit with some power. Short on the pads, Gayle whips it to deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
SIX! There's the Chris Gayle we know! Good length ball on middle, Gayle takes a few steps forward and the pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Good length ball outside off, guided to third man for a single.1 run.
On a length on middle, Simmons defends it back to the bowler.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Josh Hazlewood.
Full outside off, Gayle shoulders arms to it.
Solid from Gayle! Full on off, Gayle prods and then blocks it to cover.
Full on middle, Gayle clips it to mid-wicket.
Who will come out at number 3? It is going to be Chris Gayle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell Starc has his revenge! He gets his first wicket of the series and Australia are off to a good start here. Length ball on middle, Fletcher looks to heave it away but gets it off the inner half and it goes to mid-wicket where Mitchell Marsh takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor line from Starc and Fletcher punishes it! Short ball around the leg stump, Fletcher swivels and pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Full on middle, Fletcher pushes it to mid on.
